newsitem.title: SPAIN: Endesa says offer to buy Fecsa, Sevillana exceeded.
newsitem.headline: Endesa says offer to buy Fecsa, Sevillana exceeded.

text.p: Spain's electrical group Endesa said on Wednesday shareholders had tendered more than the 75 percent of shares it had offered to buy in electrical groups Fecsa and Sevillana.

"According to preliminary information made available by the bourses of Madrid, Barcelona, Bilbao and Valencia the total number of shares that have accepted the offers exceeds the maximum size of the offers," Empresa Nacional de Electricidad (Endesa) said in a brief statement.

Endesa said it planned provisionally to determine which shares it would buy with a pro rata system on Thursday. The results will be made public on Friday by the Spanish Stock Market Commission, the company said.
